title: Quintessential Salty Peruvian Soybean Sprouts Stir Fry
description: A salty and savory Peruvian dish featuring soybean sprouts, perfect for midnight cravings, this high protein friendly stir fry is made with kongnamul and nimono simmered to perfection.
instructions: Heat the vegetable oil in a large skillet or wok over medium high heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it is translucent and starting to caramelize.
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the soybean sprouts and cook until they are tender but still crisp, about 3 minutes.
In a small bowl, whisk together the soy sauce, lime juice, salt, and black pepper.
Pour the sauce over the soybean sprouts and stir to combine.
Add the sliced aji amarillo pepper and stir fry for an additional 2 minutes.
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed.
Serve the stir fry hot, garnished with chopped fresh cilantro or scallions if desired.
